panels.title: Exporters Up
panels.description: Prometheus target up for the NAS node_exporter and smartctl-exporter. DOWN = the box or that exporter is unreachable.

panels.title: SMART Devices (total)
panels.description: Total devices the smartctl-exporter enumerates on the NAS (whole array + cache + parity + boot). Constant regardless of spin state.

panels.title: SMART Reporting Now
panels.description: Devices currently returning SMART data. Spun-down array disks are skipped by the standby powermode check, so this is <= total by design.

panels.title: SMART Health FAILED
panels.description: Count of awake devices whose SMART overall-health self-assessment is failing (status==0). Investigate any non-zero.

panels.title: NAS Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since last boot of the Unraid host.

panels.title: /mnt/user Pool Fill
panels.description: Aggregate fill of the pooled Unraid user share (fuse.shfs across all array disks). The estate's 80% space target lives here — yellow at 80%, red at 90%.

panels.title: Array Capacity
panels.description: Total / used / free across the array data disks (/mnt/diskNN), excluding cache and parity.

panels.title: Array Used vs Free (trend)
panels.description: Array data-disk used and free bytes over time — the capacity runway.

panels.title: Per-Array-Disk Fill %
panels.description: Fill of each individual array disk (/mnt/diskNN). Unraid fills disks toward the high-water mark, so uneven fill is normal; watch for any disk approaching 100%.

panels.title: Cache / System FS Fill %
panels.description: Fill of the SSD cache pools and system filesystems (btrfs cache, root, boot).

panels.title: Filesystem Detail
panels.description: Size and free bytes for every mounted array disk, cache pool and the user pool. Instant snapshot.

panels.title: Physical Disk Read
panels.description: Read throughput per physical device (array SATA disks sdX + cache/parity NVMe). Bytes/sec.

panels.title: Physical Disk Write
panels.description: Write throughput per physical device (array SATA disks sdX + cache/parity NVMe). Bytes/sec.

panels.title: Disk Busy % (utilisation)
panels.description: Fraction of wall-clock time each device spent servicing I/O (io_time). Sustained ~100% = that disk is the bottleneck.

panels.title: CPU Busy %
panels.description: Host CPU utilisation (100% - idle), averaged across all cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Total vs used memory (used = total - available). Unraid uses free RAM for cache, so 'available' is the honest figure.

panels.title: Network Throughput
panels.description: Receive and transmit rate on the primary NICs (bond0 + members). Bytes/sec.

panels.title: Load Average (1 / 5 / 15m)
panels.description: Host run-queue load average.

panels.title: Memory Used %
panels.description: Used memory as a percentage of total.

panels.title: Component Temps (hwmon)
panels.description: On-board sensor temps — CPU package/cores (coretemp) and cache/parity NVMe (nvme). Always-present sensors.

panels.title: SMART Drive Temperatures
panels.description: Per-drive temperature from SMART. Spun-down array disks stop reporting — the line carries its last value (spanNulls) rather than dropping, so a gap = asleep, not hot.

panels.title: SMART Health (sleeping disks report only when awake)
SMART Overall Status (per awake device)
panels.description: Green OK / red FAIL per device currently returning SMART. Sleeping array disks simply drop out (shown as 'asleep', never red) — this panel never forces a spin-up.

panels.title: NVMe Endurance Used %
panels.description: Cache/parity NVMe wear (SSD rated-life consumed). 100% = rated endurance reached — plan replacement even if the drive still passes.

panels.title: NVMe Critical Warnings
panels.description: NVMe SMART critical-warning bitmask per cache/parity drive. Non-zero = the controller is flagging a health issue (e.g. reliability degraded / read-only).

panels.title: NVMe Available Spare %
panels.description: Remaining NVMe spare blocks vs the drive's threshold. Falling toward the threshold precedes failure.

panels.title: SMART Sector / Error Health (SATA)
panels.description: Raw counts of the SMART attributes that predict SATA disk failure. Any non-zero Reallocated/Pending/Offline-Uncorrectable is worth attention; UDMA CRC = cabling. Instant snapshot of awake disks.

panels.title: Power-On Hours & Cycles
panels.description: Age of each awake device: power-on hours (from SMART) and power-cycle count. Long-idle array disks report when spun up.
